QuestInfo.name: [Forest of Tenacity] John's Present
QuestInfo.0: Talk to John in Sleepywood again.
QuestInfo.1:
John asked you to get some Blue Violas for his wife's birthday.

Use the Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood to go to the forest. Get #b20 Blue Violas#k, said to keep their fragrance for over 500 years. Who makes this stuff up?
QuestInfo.2: I got John all #b20 Blue Violas#k. It has a nice scent to it, but 20 of them? Makes my head spin...As a sign of appreciation, John got me a nice glove he found inside a ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left that glove in there...is he allowed to give it to me like that? What if I wear this around town and run into the actual owner of it??
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
[Forest of Tenacity] Can Proceed to John's Last Present Quest

0.0: These Pink Violas you got are top quality! I'm sorry, but I have one more favor to ask.

yes.0: Thank you! I want to see the look on her face when she gets these #b#t4031026#s#k. Go to #m105040300# and use the #p1061006# to go deeper into the forest.
yes.1: Please get me #b20 #t4031026#s#k. I think 20 will cover the house with that pleasant scent. Please hurry!

no.0: I understand... my wife's birthday is coming up and I am screwed! Please come back if you have some spare time.
